user.title: Connect to PatchMon
user.description: Create a dedicated API token for Home Assistant in PatchMon (Settings → Integrations → Scoped Credentials) with only the `host:get` permission. Never grant `host:delete`: this integration only reads data.

data_description.url: Address of the PatchMon web interface, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000
data_description.token_key: The key of the API token
data_description.token_secret: The secret of the API token. PatchMon shows it only once, when the token is created.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the PatchMon token
reauth_confirm.description: PatchMon at {url} rejected the API token. Enter a valid token key and secret with the `host:get` permission.
